id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Controller-centric memory bus: a memory controller + DDR4 PHY drives a single 64-bit (72-bit ECC) command/address/data channel to one or more ranks of DDR4 SDRAMs on a DIMM. Command/address may be fly-by routed (write leveling compensates); RDIMM/LRDIMM re-clock it through an RCD.

supported_topologies.name: Direct / on-package
supported_topologies.description: Controller to a single DDR4 device or soldered-down devices.

supported_topologies.name: RDIMM
supported_topologies.description: Registered DIMM: an RCD re-clocks command/address.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-rank
supported_topologies.description: Multiple ranks selected by per-rank CS_n.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Issues all commands, owns timing/training, drives CK/CA and write data.
Responds to commands; returns read data on DQS; reports errors on ALERT_n.

fields.interconnect_role: DDR4 is a synchronous memory bus: the controller is the single master of a single 64-bit channel, addressing rows/columns within bank groups and banks. There is no peer-to-peer or packetized routing; ordering and timing are governed by the command protocol and the bank-group timing parameters.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_burst: 8 or 4 beats per MR0 RBT + column LSB.
ordering_guarantees.across_commands: Committed in issue order; no DRAM reordering.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: DDR4 is the main-memory region itself: it is addressed by rank / bank group / bank / row / column, not by a peripheral register address. Configuration lives in the mode registers (MR0..MR6).

device_classification.controller: Master; issues commands, owns training and timing.
device_classification.dram: Slave; single 64-bit channel, x4/x8/x16, bank groups.

default_signal_values_evidence_tables: DDR4 channel / rank / bank-group / bank / row / column addressing
